props.gloss_en: the mishna: these are those whose hide is like their flesh ... [among them] the hide of the head of a tender calf
how long is a calf tender? Ulla: within its first year
R' Yochanan: as long as it suckles
horn A: Ulla means within its first year AND provided it suckles; and R' Yochanan told him: as long as it suckles
horn B: or perhaps Ulla means within its first year, whether it suckles or not; and R' Yochanan told him: within its first year AND provided it suckles
R' Yochanan, asked whether the hide of the head of a tender calf imparts impurity: it does not impart impurity
R' Yochanan: do not trouble me -- I teach it [the mishna's calf's-head clause] in the language of a single [sage]

the baraita: one who slaughters a burnt-offering intending to burn an olive-bulk of the hide beneath the tail outside its place -- unfit, and no karet; outside its time -- piggul, and one is liable to karet for it

R' Yaakov / R' Shimon: whether the hide of the hooves, the hide of the head of a tender calf, the hide beneath the tail, or all that the Sages listed for impurity as 'whose hide is like their flesh' -- to include the hide of the genitals -- outside its place: unfit, no karet; outside its time: piggul, with karet (122b.8)
